schema: SLeeLa FRUCHST frequency candidate staging v1

source.selection: First 1,000 unique NFC-normalized lexical surface forms in source frequency order. Punctuation-only tokens are excluded; source line rank and raw occurrence count are retained.
limitations: Subtitle-domain frequency ranking; not a balanced general-purpose corpus.
No POS or sense labels are supplied by this source.
English, French, and Spanish definitions remain pending.
